arcmira-mcp-arcmira-arcmira.description: Answers what YouTube shows and podcasts said: transcripts, who was mentioned, sponsors, recommendations, momentum. Use for the arcmira MCP server or CLI.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-company-watch.description: Watches a company or topic on podcasts and YouTube: what was said lately (shows, counts, momentum, quotes), then an Arcmira monitor to keep following it.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-compare-shows.description: Compares two podcasts or YouTube shows side by side: size, latest episode, what each talks about, what both cover, and shared sponsors. Uses arcmira.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-find-quotes.description: Finds exact spoken quotes and clip-ready moments on podcasts and YouTube: verbatim words, speaker, date, a timestamped link, clip start and end. Uses arcmira.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-person-research.description: Researches a person across podcasts and YouTube for interview or meeting prep: where they appeared, their own words, who discusses them. Uses arcmira.

arcmira-mcp-arcmira-sponsor-research.description: Sponsor and ad-read research on podcasts and YouTube: who sponsors a show, or which shows a brand sponsors, how often, since when. Uses arcmira.
